The impact was that the package as submitted could not be signed, and that three committed claims were false at the commit containing them.

findings.title: the package commit silently removed the STALE-INTERMEDIATE-CANDIDATE markers from UNSIGNED_GATE_PACKET.json
findings.mechanism_confirmed: Commit ce82c3b hand-added __status/__superseded_by/__reason to a GENERATED file. tools/terminal0/lrcq/classify-and-packet.mjs had no knowledge of them, so regeneration in 58b3620 dropped all three. The file still carries schema_version lrcq-activation-3 and unresolved founder-fill placeholders.
findings.authority_impact: NONE. founder_signature null, confers_no_authority true, no signed field carries its digest, PF-3 refuses any surviving '<founder' placeholder, and verifyActivation refuses schema lrcq-activation-3 outright. The defect was founder-readability and evidence honesty.

markers.__reason: precise: retired V3/intermediate packet, historical/compatibility evidence only, unresolved founder placeholders, confers no authority, refused by V4 production entrypoints

correction.generator_refuses_without_them: A FIXED required contract (REQUIRED_MARKER_KEYS / REQUIRED_STATUS / REQUIRED_SUPERSEDED_BY / REQUIRED_REASON_FACTS) is declared INDEPENDENTLY of the emitted table and checked against the emitted packet before writing.
correction.self_caught_defect_in_the_first_draft_of: The first draft validated with the emitted table's OWN key list, so deleting a marker from that table also deleted its own check — the identical defect class as PPRCHK-198-03. Found by executing the attack rather than by inspection, and corrected before the candidate was frozen.
correction.placeholders_now_visibly_classified: __unresolved_founder_placeholders enumerates every placeholder leaf mechanically, with __unresolved_founder_placeholder_count and __placeholder_note.
correction.determinism: --run-harness-candidate is now a REQUIRED frozen input; the generator no longer reads live HEAD, so the committed bytes are reproducible.
correction.complete_regeneration_recipe: PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_INSTRUCTIONS.md section 6 now names and executes ALL FOUR producing generators in order: generate-run-manifest.mjs, classify-and-packet.mjs (with the frozen input), generate-founder-gate-packet.mjs, refreeze-package.mjs.
correction.package_membership: Every producing generator is now a package member in PACKAGE_SHA256_MANIFEST.json, so the documented recipe is itself hash-covered.

findings.title: the generator refused a widened ceiling but accepted a REMOVED exclusion, emitting a founder-readable artifact keyed ten_mandatory_exclusions that listed nine
findings.mechanism_confirmed: Ceilings were checked with strict equality against a local table, so any edit refused. Exclusions were checked by ITERATING the generator's own table, so deleting an entry simply removed the iteration and nothing refused. The table was a hand-maintained duplicate of V4_SIGNED_EXCLUSIONS and was never asserted equal to it.
findings.authority_impact: NONE. The signed payload still carried all ten exclusions and verifyActivation enforces V4_SIGNED_EXCLUSIONS independently. The exposure was a founder-readable artifact that could understate what the run may never do.

correction.guard: assertAuthoritativeTables() requires exact equality — same keys, same count, same order, no missing key, no extra key, no duplicate — plus a cardinality assertion (10 exclusions / 6 ceilings) because the emitted artifact key names assert those counts.
correction.checks_now_iterate_the_authority: for (const k of LIMIT_FIELDS) ... and for (const x of EXCLUSIONS) ... — a key the authority signs can no longer drop out of the check by being deleted from a table in the generator.
correction.counts_stated_on_the_artifacts: so a short list is visible on its face

findings.title: final-head-capsule.mjs reported checks_passed 0 for a capsule whose 31 checks all passed
findings.mechanism: verifyCapsule reports each check as { name, status, detail } with status PASS/FAIL/SKIP. The receipt counted a non-existent `c.pass` field.
findings.authority_impact: NONE — the pass/fail decision has always been driven by ver.valid and ver.problems, never by this count. But a receipt that under-reports its own evidence is exactly the defect class this wave exists to correct, so it was fixed before the candidate was frozen.
findings.correction: The receipt now reports checks_total / checks_passed / checks_failed / checks_skipped from the real status field. Verified: 31 total, 31 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
findings.disclosed_because: It changed the frozen candidate SHA from 757957e to 8e8c5569a75c1a23ebc90665ee6a77023b72ae10, and an undisclosed SHA change would itself be an evidence defect.
